Synopsis:
Nadira is a witty tiefling that survived Avernus and escaped with a soul coin, a valuable currency of the Hells. She suspects the player works for the original owner of the coin, a devilish erinyes, and will have to be persuaded in order to hand it over.

Cluster Contexts:
- DEN_Stargazing.json: Nadira is a wry tiefling who escaped Avernus clutching a soul coin she believes rightfully belongs to her — and she suspects the player is an agent of the erinyes who originally owned it. Off‑screen there was a recent fight in which the player killed a bugbear that threatened Nadira, so she greets them with sarcastic gratitude; Karlach is nearby and openly interested in the coin. The coin is a valuable Hellish currency and Nadira is distrustful and defensive, noting the player's Avernus‑stained appearance; she expects the player will have to persuade, bribe, or bluff her rather than simply seize it. Choices in this scene can hinge on convincing her motives and may intersect with nearby tiefling/refugee tensions.
- PLA_Refugee_003_PostEA.json: One of a group of refugees who sold their souls to the archdevil Zariel in exchange for the strength to survive their journey to Baldur's Gate. They've agreed to capture and kill Karlach, one of the origin characters, and if they do their souls will be their own again.

This refugee is confident of her chances of survival, but unnerved by the pact they signed.
- PLA_Refugee_002_PostEA.json: Wary and abrupt. Disguised as a noble paladin of Tyr, this young is actually in league with the archdevil Zariel. She's hiding out in a tollhouse with her companions.
- UND_DuergarLoyalSergeant.json: The duergar sergeant responsible for the camp while Nere is trapped. She's yelling at the gnomes and is considerably pissed off. After realising you are a True Soul, she asks you to help free Nere from the cave-in, and you can refuse or accept. You might turn in her missing boots if you have found them You can also ask about the gnome that escaped and the scrying eye.
- Astarion_Recruitment.json: Following a trail of whispered ADs ('Psst. Over here!' 'Come on, before it's too late!') we find a pale elf, hunched down near some long grass. He insists an intellect devourer (brain monster with legs) is hiding there, trying to cajole you to look and kill it. If you approach the grass, a boar bursts out - it was a distraction while Astarion got behind you. He's on edge, but pleased to have the jump on you. He holds a blade to your throat while demanding you tell him what happened on the ship. After a mind meld (vision where he sees a glimpse of your past) you can convince him that you're both victims and should work together to find an answer. Once he realises you're not a threat his tone changes from threatening to charming.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Nadira: You have good timing. Never been much of a fighter, so wrestling a bugbear would have gone poorly. (node 77)
- Nadira: But you're not here for heroics, are you? Avernus' stench is all over your skin. (node 86)
- Nadira: Let me guess: your devil mistress sent you to get her soul coin back. Too bad. I earned it fair and square. (node 20)
- Karlach: Oh man, a soul coin? Wouldn't mind getting my hands on that... || [context] NodeContext: Very interested but maybe downplaying her interest. (node 75)
- Player: That bugbear would have crushed your skull. This is the thanks I get? (node 41)
- Nadira: Why thank you, dread slayer of bugbears. You shall live forever in my memory. || [context] NodeContext: Dramatically exaggerated/sarcastic. (node 44)
- Nadira: Now take my regards back to that pouting erinyes and leave me alone. || [context] NodeContext: Very flat, almost cold. (node 16)
- Player: How about this? You give me the coin. Now. (node 71)
- Player: You hand the coin over, or I kill you. How about that? (node 108)
- : True (node 34)
- Nadira: Considering you turned that bugbear into paste... (node 28)

context: Nadira is a wry tiefling who fled Avernus clutching a valuable soul coin she insists she earned, and she already suspects the player is an agent of the erinyes who originally owned it. Off‑screen the player just killed a bugbear that threatened her, so she greets them with sarcastic gratitude; Karlach is nearby and openly curious about the coin. The coin is Hellish currency of great worth, Nadira distrusts anyone with Avernus on their skin, and she expects to be persuaded, bribed, or bluffed rather than having it taken by force. Tensions among the refugees (some of whom made pacts with Zariel and even conspired against Karlach) color the scene and can affect how she responds.
